name: hud_ui_widget_scalar_deleting_destructor
description: HudUiWidget::ScalarDeletingDestructor runs HudUiWidget::DestructorCore, conditionally deletes the object when flags bit 0 is set, and returns the original this pointer.
known_limits: No VC byte target covers 0x4b3ce0 yet; tier S remains open for a later HudUiWidget destructor wrapper pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation at 0x4b3ce0 validates a call to HudUiWidget::DestructorCore, a low-byte test of flags bit 0, a conditional operator delete(self), and returning the original self pointer.

The native smoke verifies the non-deleting scalar path restores the base HudUiElement dispatch state and releases owned image state, and the heap scalar path with flags bit 0 set returns the original pointer after running the deleting branch.
